text:
maria: short sync - we need a concrete rollout pattern for the "proto-first" fronting change. ops asked for console visibility + sanity autosuggestions.
chris: do you mean rollout UX or routing policy itself?
sasha: both. console should expose per-route protocol split + error/success trends. idea: show grpc vs rest % + a tiny sparkline.
maria: ops wants a trigger: if 5xx > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, surface a 'recommend reduce grpc' action.
todd: agree on recommend. auto-act is risky. UI should show suggested weight and a one-click canary rollback.
jamal: telemetry can emit per-protocol 5xx, p95, translation_mismatch. we need tenant+route tags.
chris: watch cardinality. maybe we sample 10% of traffic for tenant-level histograms and keep full agg for org-level metrics.
sasha: sampling + deterministic hash so results are stable across windows. console only needs representative figures for decisioning.
maria: where does fallback live? edge proxy (fast path) or control plane (centralized)?
todd: control plane gives us central decisions and easier audit/telemetry. edge should accept routing weights and have a local fallback if control plane is unreachable.
jamal: control plane also simplifies surfacing signals into Redwood Console. we can compute derived signals there.
chris: downside: control plane adds a critical hop. must design for control plane fail-open to avoid blocking traffic.
sasha: fail-open plan: edge keeps last-known weights + static tenant fallback policy. config TTL, and an admin knob to tighten behavior.
maria: protobuf vs json: do we transcode at the gateway or maintain dual endpoints?
todd: prefer encouraging gRPC/protobuf for internal clients. provide a lightweight JSON bridge for external SDKs. full runtime transcoding is costly and brittle.
chris: add a parity test in the canary: run N requests through both proto and json path compare key fields. if mismatch > threshold -> rollback.
jamal: will add translation_mismatch metric. make it a counter + sample mismatches with payload snippet (sanitized).
sasha: rollout modal mock: show current split, recent p95/5xx by protocol, mismatch rate, and three actions: inc grpc, dec grpc, pause canary. plus note field and links to runbook.
maria: permissions: only owners + SRE can apply suggested actions. UI must show actor and timestamp. audit log entry created for every weight change.
chris: reuse existing ACL/audit machinery from deploys. emit event to event-log for downstream billing/alerts.
todd: agreement check: proto-first routing, control-plane suggestions, edge local fallback, parity checks in canary, mismatch telemetry. any objections?
sasha: none. i'll wire the modal mock to the runbook link and include a small play excerpt.
jamal: @deploy-bot please create a canary job: proto-fronting-parity-checker
deploy-bot: Canary job created: proto-fronting-parity-checker. template includes: p95 by protocol, 5xx rate, translation_mismatch_rate, sample_mismatch_logs. Manual trigger.
maria: thanks all. owners: chris -> telemetry hook + sampling, jamal -> mismatch metric + sample logs, sasha -> UI mock, todd -> edge fallback config + TTL. sync tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:
